read: ATRL trades at a trailing P/E of 4.59 against a 7% net margin, and the desk's composite fair value (1012.03) sits about 11% above the current price (913.67), though the four valuation methods disagree wildly (DDM 41 vs Graham 1397), so the 'fair' verdict should be read as low-confidence rather than a tight anchor. The refining business itself is thin-margin and commodity-exposed by nature, which caps how much comfort a low P/E alone should give. The dividend is token-sized (0.54% yield, 3.73% payout) so it is not the reason to hold this name, but it is trivially well covered by current earnings. No leverage or balance-sheet detail is in this feed, which is a real gap for a capital-intensive refiner.
